narrative: Sensor lifecycle, chip-ID selection, mode negotiation, native allocation layouts, capture/stream timing and retained CSI frame checks pass. Display checks cover public EDID dumps, DisplayID, every implemented CTA timing against Linux, attachment generations, panel sequences and actual DSI session binding for 720p/1080p with retained failures; independent sanitizer testing covers 20,000 mutated EDIDs. USB checks cover the shared camera lifecycle, all advertised frame intervals, original spans, stale release tickets and detach; existing UVC protocol, HID recording replay, serial protocol/lifetime and composed xHCI/TinyUSB class checks pass; Type-C tests inject PMIC failure through the published power-authority state and cover attachment, fault shutdown, retained resources and monitoring. OS-only, hello-compute and external mimus baseline builds pass; the selected integration gate passes OS linkage, kernel boot and check-index verification; the USB-class native objects compile with class services and interrupt completion enabled. The composed DSI host fixture and AArch64 compilation check the changed DSI application/provider branches; the standalone DSI application configure hits a rejected hunk in apps/storage-read-single-core/platform.patch. Restrictions: the native CSI workload requires YUV422 input and NV16 output, so the RAW10 OV5647 is refused; exposure, gain and white-balance are unsupported in the sensor adapters, test-pattern selection is implemented before streaming; the common parser handles up to eight EDID blocks, HDMI transport holds four, DP's 256-byte copied-result ABI admits at most one EDID extension; the PLL planner refuses the Innolux P079ZCA 56.9 MHz mode and the LCD planner refuses the LG LH500WX1-SD03 1280-line height; parallel LCD has no native board route; Type-C setup requires FUSB302 on S_TWI1; CSI EL0 publication and independent drain are open. Source identities are in drivers/camera/sensor-sources.json, docs/display-class-sources.json, docs/usb-uvc-sources.json, docs/usb-hid-sources.json and docs/usb-serial-sources.json.
